annotations.text:
Config as an app, not a form.
Everything is live — switch sections, drag the sliders, watch the right rail respond.

Three structural moves: a persistent left nav instead of browser-style tabs, a right rail that shows the consequence of every edit without scrolling, and advanced knobs folded behind disclosures so the common path stays short.
Phone. The outcome pins to the top since it cannot sit beside the form, and navigation moves to a thumb-reachable bottom bar.
